paras: Hi Bruno! Welcome to the summer basketball camp in Los Angeles. We are very happy to have you with us this year.
Your coach is Coach Parker. She is thirty-five years old and she is from Los Angeles. Her group is group two, on court B.
Your roommate is Tyler. He is sixteen. He is a student at Lincoln High School. His family is from Los Angeles too. He is not a beginner -- he plays every day.
You are not alone: there are twenty students in group two. Are you ready? See you on Monday!

listenings.text: Hello, this is Coach Parker from the basketball camp. I have a short message about next week. The camp is not at the school this year. We are at the city sports center, on Grand Avenue. And the first day is not Monday: it is Tuesday. Please be there at nine in the morning. Bring water and good shoes. Is your son ready? Thank you, and see you on Tuesday.

Hi Bruno, this is Tyler. I am your roommate this summer. Let me tell you about my family. My father is a doctor. His name is Robert. My mother is a teacher. Her name is Susan. She is not American. She is from Canada. I have two brothers and one sister. My sister is nine. Her name is Emma. She is not a basketball fan. My brothers are twelve and nineteen. See you on Tuesday.

extra_audio.text: Bruno opens the email from the camp. He reads the name of his coach. He reads the name of his roommate. He writes an answer to the camp. He says he is ready.
